text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Air Shakur finished all of today's 
training menu—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No good. I ain't reachin' it like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you go on home. I'm gonna keep going 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are still parts she isn't 
satisfied with, and she intends to do some 
extra training.
choice_data_list:
I'll be watching right here until the very 
end.

Any more than this will lead to 
overworking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Do what you want. Just don't get in my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Good evening, Shakur, Trainer. Still in 
the middle of training?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we run a tandem 
workout together right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aah? Why the hell do I have to tag along 
with you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh♪ Actually, my times got even 
faster recently. Don't you wanna collect 
some data on me, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"If I run alongside her, maybe I'll get to 
see what I'm looking for♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Quite the confidence you have. ...If 
you're bluffing, I'm stopping immediately.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If that's true, will you keep running 
alongside me from now on?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why are you the one making the deal? 
Whatever, let's just get started.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Shakur did extra training 
until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Necessary training isn't what you'd 
call overworking.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you're just going to bring up 
generalities, a textbook is more than 
enough. Or do you actually have some 
thoughts of your own?
choice_data_list:
There's still plenty you can do even 
without running.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hoh... what's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't Shakur-kun. You're just 
the right person for this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Tch, a pain in the ass showed up. What 
the hell do you mean, "the right person 
for the job"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, in order to advance my research, 
I wanted an objective assessment of my own 
running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're wrapping up your training, would 
you mind recording my run?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So you're totally raring to run, 
huh.
choice_data_list:
You can learn a lot just by watching, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I already know that much. I've been 
gathering data this whole time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Forget running. I'll watch how this one 
runs. Prioritizing data seems like the 
better move here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Shakur was successfully 
prevented from overworking herself.
